title: Joomla capture: a template language string written with HTML entities is captured as plain words, not as the entity
steps: S1: Run capture-contract.py --full-coverage on a fixture site whose template language file holds TPL_ROOMS="Rooms & suites", TPL_OPEN="We’re open – daily" and TPL_PLAIN="Tea & cake".
expect: S1: TPL_ROOMS and TPL_OPEN each get one text slot with the decoded words and an xpath to the text node; the lock keeps the value as written; TPL_PLAIN stays one plain text slot without an xpath.
evidence: Before the fix JA Voyara j6 1.0.12 failed Road to live rule NAME-4 on three & samples; after it NAME-4 passes on the 1.0.12 pack
fence: Capture only; the plugin's write through the xpath is the same path a language string with markup already takes
